geography: Panel or one of seven custom reporting groups; not official nine English regions
authorities: Matched authority count retained in both selected periods
approved_2026_q3: Approved application records in provisional Q3 2026
rate_up_count_down: True when approval rate increases and approval count decreases
approvals_at_2025_rate_2026_decision_vol: 2026 known decisions times unrounded 2025 rate; fractional result is a benchmark, not an observed record count
actual_approvals_minus_fixed_rate_benchm: 2026 observed approvals minus fixed-rate benchmark; not causal attribution
